lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Impressive. Not many could trudge through this swamp and make it this far.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Shanks! I don't have time to waste in the muck. Step aside!

lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Putting your life on the line takes real guts. Show me your resolve has what it takes to survive the seas ahead.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I'll bet my life on this blade then!

lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Draw your sword! Let's see how much weight your ambitions carry!
